{{Quote|I was organizing fresh recruits when Imperials stormed inside. They rounded us up, threw us in the cage.|Vell Narroc|<ref name="The Search for Agent Galen" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], forces of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] '''seized''' the [[Power Guard recruitment center]] in the [[Nikto Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The operation was carried out on the orders of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sadic]], who sought to capture the Republic's [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard supersoldier project]] as part of his master [[Darth Angral]]'s [[Desolator crisis|campaign]] of vengeance against the Republic. After learning of the center's location by [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] the [[Unidentified Republic operative|operative]] in charge of the project, Sadic's forces captured the facility and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] the recruiter [[Vell Narroc]] and the volunteers. At Sadic's orders, the Imperials began taking the project's volunteers to the [[Power Guard Cybernetics Lab|project lab]] for experimentation. The facility was later liberated by a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]], but most of the refugees had already been taken by that [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="The Search for Agent Galen" />

==Behind the scenes==
The capture of the recruitment center was first mentioned in the Jedi Knight class mission "The Search for Agent Galen" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="The Search for Agent Galen" />
